blocks.text: Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) Plays a Trick on Hadhrat Suwaybit (RA)

Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) once went on a trade journey to Busra. Accompanying him were Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) and Hadhrat Suwaybit bin Harmala (RA), both of whom were veterans of the Battle of Badr. Because Hadhrat Suwaybit (RA) was in charge of the goods, Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) asked him for something to eat. Hadhrat Suwaybit (RA) refused saying that they would have to wait for Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) who was a joker and full of tricks, went to the people (of the locality), with his camel in trail. "Who will buy from me an intelligent Arab slave?" he announced. When some people agreed to the sale, Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) warned, "He is however a good talker and may claim to be a free person. If you intend letting him go on this pretext of his, then let me be and do not complicate matters for me (do not make the purchase)." "No!" the people insisted, "We shall buy him from you in exchange for ten young camels."
Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) then returned, leading the camels (and the buyers) along with him. He then said to them, "There he is. Grab him!" Hadhrat Suwaybit (RA) pleaded, "He is lying! I am a free man." "He has already told us about you," the people said as they threw a rope around his neck and took him away. When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) returned and was informed about what had happened, he went to the people with his companions, returned the ten camels to them and got Hadhrat Suwaybit (RA) back. Rasulullaah ﷺ was also informed about the incident and it kept him and the Sahabah (RA) laughing for an entire year afterwards.[^1]
Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) plays a trick on a Bedouin

Hadhrat Rabee'ah bin Uthmaan (RA) narrates that a Bedouin once came to see Rasulullaah ﷺ and put his camel to sit in the courtyard of the Masjid. Some of the Sahabah (RA) then suggested to Hadhrat Nu'aymaan bin Amr Ansaari (RA) who was referred to as An-Nu'aymaan, "We have a strong desire to eat some meat so why don't you slaughter that camel for us to eat. Rasulullaah ﷺ will then recompense the owner for it."
Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) went ahead to slaughter it and when the Bedouin came out of the Masjid and saw his camel slaughtered, he screamed, "Oh dear! My camel has been slaughtered, O Muhammad!" Rasulullaah ﷺ came out and asked, "Who did that?" When the Sahabah (RA) informed him that it was Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ searched for him.
